tasks.title: Conversation #101
tasks.transcript:
Man: Hey Susan, are you planning to hit the gym later today?
Woman: I am. But only after I wrap up the quarterly report. It's taking longer than expected, so I'll probably head over in the evening. I usually go earlier.
Man: I've been thinking about getting back into a routine myself. It's been weeks since I last worked out. I could use a bit of motivation.
Woman: Well, if you're up for it, we could do a session together. I was planning to focus on strength training today.
Man: That sounds like a good idea.

questions.stem: Why is the woman going to the gym in the evening?

options.A: She needs to finish some work first.
options.B: She made plans with some friends.
options.C: The gym was closed for an afternoon event.
options.D: The gym is too crowded during the day.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：女士为什么晚上去健身房？ 定位原文：Woman: I am. But only after I wrap up the quarterly report. It's taking longer than expected, so I'll probably head over in the evening. 选项分析： A. She needs to finish some work first. 她需要先完成一些工作。女士明确说要先写完季度报告，所以A选项正确。 B. She made plans with some friends. 她和朋友有约。对话中未提及朋友，所以B选项错误。 C. The gym was closed for an afternoon event. 健身房因下午的活动关闭了。对话中未提及健身房关闭，所以C选项错误。 D. The gym is too crowded during the day. 白天健身房太挤了。对话中未提及拥挤情况，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What is the man's attitude toward exercising?

options.B: He prefers to work out alone.
options.C: He wants to, but he needs encouragement.
options.D: He is very motivated and exercises frequently.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：男士对于锻炼的态度是什么？ 定位原文：Man: I could use a bit of motivation. 选项分析： A. He is uninterested in it. 他对锻炼不感兴趣。男士主动提起想恢复锻炼，说明他有兴趣，所以A选项错误。 B. He prefers to work out alone. 他更喜欢独自锻炼。男士主动接受女士一起锻炼的提议，说明他不排斥一起练，所以B选项错误。 C. He wants to, but he needs encouragement. 他想锻炼，但需要鼓励。男士说“需要一点动力”，说明他有意愿但缺乏动力，所以C选项正确。 D. He is very motivated and exercises frequently. 他非常有动力且经常锻炼。男士说已经几周没锻炼了，说明并不经常锻炼，所以D选项错误。
